headline: Optimize your daily health metrics
body: Track sleep, workouts, and vitals in one science-backed app. Get data-driven insights and proactive suggestions for tests when your metrics shift.
rationale: This copy addresses the Wellness Optimizer by treating her body like a system to be optimized. It avoids low-tier price mentions and novelty, focusing strictly on science-backed claims, ingredient and data transparency, and outcome-focused tracking.
